title: Which of These Best Describes Multiple Choice Evaluation with LLMs? A) Forced B) Flawed C) Fixable D) All of the Above
reasoning: The paper identifies itself as a survey and position paper that evaluates the methodological flaws of the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) format. While it mentions that MCQA is used to test subjectivity in areas like morals, the paper itself focuses on evaluation format methodology rather than conducting or presenting a benchmark for religion, faith, or specific ethical frameworks.
